title: BLADE: Auditing Information Use for Failure Attribution in LLM Multi-Agent Systems
title_zh: BLADE：通过审计信息使用来定位大型语言模型多智能体系统中的故障原因

paragraphs.en: https://github.com/GXG-CS/BLADE \paperabstract Large language model multi-agent systems extend individual agents’ capabilities through collaboration across specialized roles, tools, and workflows. Yet collaboration makes failures harder to diagnose: one agent may misinterpret a correct result while others carry the mistake forward. Failure attribution therefore seeks to identify the responsible agent and decisive error step. Recent methods trace dependencies, but knowing where information came from is not the same as knowing where it went wrong. We introduce BLADE ( B lame L ocalization via A udited D ependency E vidence), a training-free framework that moves beyond tracing information to auditing its use. Using Jev for structured probabilistic judgments, BLADE uses dependency probabilities to select relevant source–decision handoffs for auditing. At these handoffs, it examines whether receiving decisions use their sources faithfully and within task requirements, distinguishing error introduction, propagation, and repair. These findings inform a global diagnosis that considers all execution steps. Without reference answers, BLADE achieves the best or tied-best step accuracy among eight strategies under a shared Jev decision interface on 1,228 failed runs across five Who&When and Who&When Pro subsets, outperforming All-at-once by 2.2–11.1 percentage points. Making responsibility evidence explicit offers a path toward more interpretable and reliable agentic systems.
paragraphs.zh: https://github.com/GXG-CS/BLADE \paperabstract 大型语言模型多智能体系统通过跨专业角色、工具和流程的协作，扩展了单个智能体的能力。 然而，协作使得故障诊断更加困难：一个智能体可能误解正确的结果，而其他智能体则会继续传递这一错误。 因此，故障归因旨在识别负有责任的智能体以及决定性的错误步骤。 近期方法虽然能够追踪依赖关系，但了解信息来自何处，并不等同于了解其出错之处。 我们提出了 BLADE（通过审计依赖证据进行定位），一个无需训练的框架，它超越了信息追踪，转而审计信息的使用过程。 BLADE 使用 Jev 进行结构化概率判断，并通过依赖概率选择相关的源-决策交接点以进行审计。 在这些交接点上，BLADE 会检查接收到的决策是否忠实于其来源且符合任务要求，从而区分错误的引入、传播和修复。 这些发现为全局诊断提供了依据，该诊断会考虑所有执行步骤。 在没有参考答案的情况下，BLADE 在五个 Who&When 和 Who&When Pro 子集上共 1,228 次失败运行中，于共享的 Jev 决策接口下，八种策略中实现了最佳或并列最佳的步骤准确率，比 All-at-once 高出 2.2–11.1 个百分点。 将责任证据显性化，为构建更具可解释性和可靠性的智能体系统提供了可行路径。

paragraphs.en: Large language model (LLM)-based agents are increasingly being developed to tackle complex tasks through sustained reasoning, tool use, and multi-agent collaboration ( Fourney et al., 2024 ; Luo et al., 2026 ) . These advances are enabling increasingly sophisticated workflows in software engineering, web-based tasks, and scientific discovery ( Hong et al., 2024 ; Ghareeb et al., 2026 ) . However, as these systems undertake more complex and interdependent tasks, diagnosing their failures becomes increasingly challenging. Errors arising from incorrect reasoning, misinterpreted observations, or faulty information exchange may propagate across multiple agents before surfacing in the final outcome ( Cemri et al., 2025 ; Lin et al., 2026 ) . Consequently, observing a failed outcome, or identifying erroneous intermediate decisions, does not necessarily reveal which mistakes were responsible for the failure ( Zhang et al., 2025 ; Qi et al., 2026 ) . This challenge motivates the study of failure attribution, which seeks to locate decisive errors and assign responsibility within execution trajectories, providing a foundation for debugging, corrective feedback, and improving the reliability of agentic systems ( Zhang et al., 2025 ; Chen et al., 2026 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 基于大型语言模型（LLM）的智能体正被越来越多地开发出来，以通过持续推理、工具使用和多智能体协作来处理复杂任务（Fourney 等人，2024；Luo 等人，2026）。 这些进步正在软件工程、基于网络的任务和科学发现领域催生出日益复杂的流程（Hong 等人，2024；Ghareeb 等人，2026）。 然而，随着这些系统承担更复杂且相互依赖的任务，诊断其故障变得愈发困难。 由错误推理、观察结果误判或信息交换故障引发的错误，可能在最终结果显现之前，在多个智能体之间传播（Cemri 等人，2025；Lin 等人，2026）。 因此，观察到失败的结果或识别出错误的中间决策，并不一定能揭示哪些错误导致了该失败（Zhang 等人，2025；Qi 等人，2026）。 这一挑战推动了故障归因研究的发展，该研究旨在定位关键性错误并明确执行轨迹中的责任归属，从而为调试、纠正反馈以及提升智能体系统的可靠性提供基础（Zhang 等人，2025；Chen 等人，2026）。

paragraphs.en: Despite its importance, failure attribution in multi-agent systems presents three closely related challenges. First, identifying relevant interactions is difficult, as critical decisions may depend on information from distant steps and multiple agents, making it difficult to determine which dependencies deserve closer attention ( Rafi et al., 2026 ; Deng et al., 2026 ) . Second, tracing dependencies alone is not enough to establish responsibility. An agent may faithfully pass along incorrect information or introduce a new error by misinterpreting a correct source ( Cemri et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2025 ) . For example, as shown in Figure 1 , a code execution correctly identifies Braintree and Honolulu as the farthest-apart birthplaces of U.S. presidents, but a subsequent agent misreads the result as Honolulu and Quincy, which is then carried into the final answer. The error therefore arises not from the original source, but from how its information is interpreted. Third, identifying local errors does not necessarily lead to a correct overall attribution, since some mistakes may be corrected later, while others may have little impact on the final outcome ( Qi et al., 2026 ; Rafi et al., 2026 ) . Together, these challenges call for an approach that goes beyond tracing dependencies to examine how agents use information and how local evidence contributes to the overall diagnosis.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管失败归因在多智能体系统中至关重要，但它仍面临三个相互关联的挑战。 首先，识别相关交互十分困难，因为关键决策可能依赖于遥远步骤和多个智能体的信息，这使得难以确定哪些依赖关系需要更密切的关注（Rafi 等，2026；Deng 等，2026）。 其次，仅追溯依赖关系并不足以确立责任归属。 一个智能体可能会忠实地传递错误信息，或因误解正确来源而引入新的错误（Cemri 等，2025；Zhang 等，2025）。 例如，如图 1 所示，一段代码执行正确地识别出 Braintree 和 Honolulu 是美国总统出生地中相距最远的两个地点，但后续的一个智能体却将结果误读为 Honolulu 和 Quincy，这一错误随后被带入最终答案。 因此，这个错误并非源于原始来源，而是源于其信息被解读的方式。 第三，识别局部错误并不必然导致正确的整体归因，因为某些错误可能在后续得到纠正，而另一些错误可能对最终结果影响甚微（Qi 等，2026；Rafi 等，2026）。 综合来看，这些挑战要求一种超越依赖关系追溯的方法，以考察智能体如何使用信息以及局部证据如何为整体诊断提供依据。

paragraphs.en: Recent studies have explored several approaches to failure attribution. Counterfactual replay has been used to construct training supervision for attribution models ( Zhang et al., 2026 ) , while repeated-run analyses assess the contributions of individual agent actions ( Ge et al., 2026 ) . Dependency-guided methods trace information flow and error propagation across execution steps ( Rafi et al., 2026 ; Deng et al., 2026 ) . Other approaches examine how errors evolve over time, verify failure hypotheses, or check for violations of task and tool requirements ( Qi et al., 2026 ; Li et al., 2026 ; Barke et al., 2026 ) . These advances have improved our understanding of how failures develop. Building on this progress, we ask how information use at source–decision handoffs can provide explicit evidence of responsibility. Beyond identifying which steps are connected, we argue that attribution should examine what an agent receives, how it uses that information, and whether its decisions satisfy the task’s requirements. This motivates treating each source–decision handoff as a unit for collecting evidence of error introduction, propagation, and repair. Since these interactions can be numerous and their assessment uncertain, such analysis calls for selective, structured judgments over a shared execution context, with their probabilities informing the final diagnosis.

paragraphs.en: To realize this perspective, we introduce BLADE ( B lame L ocalization via A udited D ependency E vidence), a training-free framework that moves beyond tracing information flow to examining responsibility at agent handoffs. At its core, BLADE extends a dependency graph into a blame graph: rather than merely recording which decisions rely on earlier information, it also captures how that information is used and where errors may be introduced, propagated, or repaired. BLADE first reconstructs relationships among execution steps and uses their probabilities to select relevant source–decision handoffs for closer examination. Inspired by contract-based blame assignment ( Findler and Felleisen, 2002 ; Wadler and Findler, 2009 ) , it then audits how each receiving decision interprets and applies its source under the task’s requirements, distinguishing newly introduced violations from inherited errors and repairs. The resulting findings are associated with the audited handoffs as structured evidence rather than fixed blame assignments. BLADE implements these judgments with Jev, whose decision interface evaluates independent structured questions in parallel over a shared execution context and returns probabilities over predefined alternatives. Finally, BLADE combines the blame graph with the complete trajectory to identify the decisive error and assign responsibility, keeping every execution step as a candidate and allowing the global diagnosis to override uncertain local findings.
paragraphs.zh: 为实现这一视角，我们提出了 BLADE（通过审计依赖证据进行归因），一个无需训练的框架，它超越了信息流追踪，转而审视智能体交接时的责任归属。 BLADE 的核心是将依赖图扩展为归因图：它不仅记录哪些决策依赖于早期信息，还捕捉了这些信息如何被使用，以及错误可能在哪里被引入、传播或修复。 BLADE 首先重建执行步骤之间的关系，并利用其概率选择相关的源-决策交接点进行深入分析。 受基于合同的归因方法（Findler and Felleisen, 2002；Wadler and Findler, 2009）启发，BLADE 随后审计每个接收决策如何根据任务要求解释和应用其来源，从而区分新出现的违规与继承的错误及修复。 最终得出的结论以结构化证据的形式与经过审计的交接点相关联，而非作为固定的责任判定。 BLADE 通过 Jev 实现这些判断：Jev 的决策接口可在共享的执行上下文中并行评估独立的结构化问题，并返回预定义选项的概率分布。 最后，BLADE 将归因图与完整执行轨迹相结合，以识别关键错误并分配责任，其中每个执行步骤都被视为潜在候选，且全局诊断可覆盖不确定的局部结论。

sents.en: To realize this perspective, we introduce BLADE ( B lame L ocalization via A udited D ependency E vidence), a training-free framework that moves beyond tracing information flow to examining responsibility at agent handoffs.
sents.zh: 为实现这一视角，我们提出了 BLADE（通过审计依赖证据进行归因），一个无需训练的框架，它超越了信息流追踪，转而审视智能体交接时的责任归属。

sents.en: At its core, BLADE extends a dependency graph into a blame graph: rather than merely recording which decisions rely on earlier information, it also captures how that information is used and where errors may be introduced, propagated, or repaired.
sents.zh: BLADE 的核心是将依赖图扩展为归因图：它不仅记录哪些决策依赖于早期信息，还捕捉了这些信息如何被使用，以及错误可能在哪里被引入、传播或修复。

sents.en: BLADE first reconstructs relationships among execution steps and uses their probabilities to select relevant source–decision handoffs for closer examination.
sents.zh: BLADE 首先重建执行步骤之间的关系，并利用其概率选择相关的源-决策交接点进行深入分析。

sents.en: Inspired by contract-based blame assignment ( Findler and Felleisen, 2002 ; Wadler and Findler, 2009 ) , it then audits how each receiving decision interprets and applies its source under the task’s requirements, distinguishing newly introduced violations from inherited errors and repairs.
sents.zh: 受基于合同的归因方法（Findler and Felleisen, 2002；Wadler and Findler, 2009）启发，BLADE 随后审计每个接收决策如何根据任务要求解释和应用其来源，从而区分新出现的违规与继承的错误及修复。

sents.en: The resulting findings are associated with the audited handoffs as structured evidence rather than fixed blame assignments.
sents.zh: 最终得出的结论以结构化证据的形式与经过审计的交接点相关联，而非作为固定的责任判定。

sents.en: BLADE implements these judgments with Jev, whose decision interface evaluates independent structured questions in parallel over a shared execution context and returns probabilities over predefined alternatives.
sents.zh: BLADE 通过 Jev 实现这些判断：Jev 的决策接口可在共享的执行上下文中并行评估独立的结构化问题，并返回预定义选项的概率分布。

sents.en: Finally, BLADE combines the blame graph with the complete trajectory to identify the decisive error and assign responsibility, keeping every execution step as a candidate and allowing the global diagnosis to override uncertain local findings.
sents.zh: 最后，BLADE 将归因图与完整执行轨迹相结合，以识别关键错误并分配责任，其中每个执行步骤都被视为潜在候选，且全局诊断可覆盖不确定的局部结论。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate BLADE on 1,228 failed executions across five subsets of Who&When and Who&When Pro, covering diverse multi-agent architectures and both natural and injected failures. Under a shared Jev decision interface, BLADE achieves the best or tied-best step attribution accuracy among eight compared strategies on every subset. Our ablations support the central distinction between tracing information and auditing its use: dependency information alone yields mixed improvements, whereas adding handoff-level audit findings improves step accuracy by 2.4–3.4 percentage points across all four subsets examined. Shuffling dependency edges and audit findings across event pairs reduces accuracy, highlighting the importance of grounding evidence in the interactions it describes. Dependency-guided auditing matches or outperforms exhaustive auditing on three subsets while examining only 13–23% as many handoffs. These results demonstrate the value of using dependencies to guide targeted audits and the evidence to support global attribution.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在 Who&When 和 Who&When Pro 的五个子集上，针对 1,228 次执行失败的情况对 BLADE 进行了评估，这些子集涵盖了多样的多智能体架构以及自然发生的和人为注入的故障。 在共享的 Jev 决策接口下，BLADE 在所有子集上都实现了八个对比策略中最佳或并列最佳的步骤归因准确率。 我们的消融研究支持对信息追踪与其使用审计之间的核心区分：仅依赖依赖关系信息带来的改进效果不一，而加入移交层审计结果后，在全部四个受测子集中，步骤准确率提升了 2.4–3.4 个百分点。 打乱事件对之间的依赖边和审计结果会降低准确率，这凸显了将证据锚定在其所描述交互中的重要性。 依赖关系引导的审计在三个子集上达到了与全面审计相同或更优的性能，而仅需检查 13–23% 数量的移交操作。 这些结果表明，利用依赖关系指导针对性审计以及支持全局归因的证据具有重要价值。

paragraphs.en: Beyond Dependency Tracing. We identify source–decision handoffs as units for collecting responsibility evidence, distinguishing information provenance from how that information is used. Dependency tracing reveals how information flows between agents, but not whether an error originates in a receiving decision or is inherited from an upstream source. We argue that source–decision handoffs are therefore critical to understanding how failures arise and propagate.

This evidence informs a global diagnosis in which all execution steps remain candidates.

paragraphs.en: Empirical Insights. Experiments on 1,228 failed trajectories across five benchmark subsets reveal that dependency information alone offers inconsistent benefits, whereas handoff auditing consistently improves attribution across the four subsets examined in our ablations. Selective auditing also matches or outperforms exhaustive auditing on three subsets, showing that inspecting more interactions does not necessarily improve attribution.

paragraphs.en: Who&When ( Zhang et al., 2025 ) established agent- and step-level failure attribution, with subsequent benchmarks covering injected failures ( Liu et al., 2026 ) and richer execution traces ( Chen et al., 2026 ) . Beyond direct trajectory judgments, AgenTracer ( Zhang et al., 2026 ) trains an attribution model on supervision derived from counterfactual replay, while FAMAS ( Ge et al., 2026 ) estimates responsibility across repeated executions. These approaches obtain additional attribution signals through training or repeated runs, motivating complementary forms of diagnosis.
paragraphs.zh: Who&When（Zhang 等人，2025）建立了智能体级和步骤级的故障归因方法，随后的基准测试涵盖了注入的故障（Liu 等人，2026）和更丰富的执行轨迹（Chen 等人，2026）。 除了直接的轨迹判断外，AgenTracer（Zhang 等人，2026）基于反事实重播产生的监督信号训练了归因模型，而 FAMAS（Ge 等人，2026）则估算了重复执行过程中的责任分配。 这些方法通过训练或重复运行获得了额外的归因信号，从而催生了互补的诊断形式。

paragraphs.en: Other methods focus on collecting evidence of failure. AgentRx ( Barke et al., 2026 ) checks task and tool constraints, ErrorProbe ( Li et al., 2026 ) verifies failure hypotheses through tool-grounded execution, and TrajDebug ( Qi et al., 2026 ) tracks errors through their correction and downstream impact. Together, they highlight an important distinction: detecting an error is not equivalent to establishing responsibility. In collaborative workflows, this often depends on how agents interpret and use information produced by others.
paragraphs.zh: 其他方法则专注于收集失败的证据。 AgentRx（Barke 等人，2026）会检查任务和工具约束；ErrorProbe（Li 等人，2026）通过基于工具的执行来验证失败假设；而 TrajDebug（Qi 等人，2026）则会追踪错误及其修正过程以及后续影响。 综合来看，这些方法凸显了一个重要区别：检测错误并不等同于确定责任。 在协作流程中，这通常取决于智能体如何解释和使用他人生成的信息。

paragraphs.en: Dependency-aware methods examine these cross-step interactions. CHIEF ( Wang et al., 2026a ) and DCFA ( Wang et al., 2026b ) organize failures through causal-inspired structures, while TRIAGE ( Wang, 2026 ) ranks steps by suspicion and structural impact. More closely related, FALAT ( Rafi et al., 2026 ) uses dependencies to distinguish error origins, propagation, and correction, whereas DeFA ( Deng et al., 2026 ) combines event dependencies with failure propagation analysis. These methods demonstrate the value of structural evidence, yet a dependency does not itself establish whether the receiving decision used its source correctly. Moreover, uncertain local evidence raises the question of which interactions warrant closer examination and how strongly they should influence attribution.

paragraphs.en: This distinction echoes data provenance and program slicing, which trace information dependencies ( Buneman et al., 2001 ; Weiser, 1981 ) , and contract-based blame assignment, which examines responsibility at interaction boundaries ( Findler and Felleisen, 2002 ) . BLADE builds on these ideas by using dependency probabilities to select source–decision handoffs for targeted auditing. Its typed findings capture how information is used, distinguishing error introduction from propagation and repair. Unlike candidate-focused adjudication in DeFA, these findings do not restrict the final search space: every step remains eligible for global attribution. Dependencies thus guide where to inspect, while the resulting evidence informs where responsibility lies.

Rather than using dependencies to directly determine blame, it uses them to guide targeted inspection of source–decision handoffs. These audits provide structured evidence about how information is used, while the final diagnosis considers the complete trajectory without restricting the candidate events (Figure 2 , Algorithm 1 ). We implement these judgments with Jev, a decision model that returns probabilities over predefined alternatives rather than free-form text.

paragraphs.en: The first challenge in constructing responsibility evidence is identifying which interactions warrant closer examination. In multi-agent trajectories, a decision may rely on a distant instruction, tool result, or intermediate claim rather than the immediately preceding event. Program slicing and data provenance have long studied how outputs depend on earlier computations and information ( Weiser, 1981 ; Buneman et al., 2001 ) . In agent trajectories, however, many relevant dependencies are implicit in natural-language interactions and must be inferred from trajectory context. BLADE reconstructs these relations as probabilistic evidence, using them to guide targeted auditing rather than directly determining responsibility.
paragraphs.zh: 构建责任证据时的首要挑战是确定哪些交互需要更深入的审查。 在多智能体轨迹中，某个决策可能依赖于遥远的指令、工具结果或中间主张，而非紧邻其前的事件。 程序切片和数据来源研究长期以来一直在探讨输出如何依赖早期的计算和信息（Weiser, 1981；Buneman 等，2001）。 然而，在智能体轨迹中，许多相关依赖关系隐含在自然语言交互中，必须从轨迹上下文中推断出来。 BLADE 将这些关系重构为概率性证据，并以此指导针对性审计，而非直接确定责任。

paragraphs.en: An erroneous decision need not be the source of its own error. The same incorrect claim may reflect a misinterpretation of a correct source or faithful propagation of an upstream mistake. Drawing on contract-based blame assignment ( Findler and Felleisen, 2002 ) , it examines whether receiving decisions use their sources faithfully and in accordance with the task’s requirements.

paragraphs.en: Handoff-level evidence reveals how errors are introduced, propagated, or repaired, but does not necessarily identify the decisive error. A local breach may be corrected later, have no effect on the outcome, or coexist with other errors. Conversely, a decisive error may lack an audit finding. Confidence in an information-use label does not imply that the corresponding event is responsible for the failure. Although each audit considers the complete trajectory, it answers a handoff-specific question. Global diagnosis must additionally determine which error was decisive for the failed execution.
paragraphs.zh: 交接层面的证据揭示了错误是如何引入、传播或修复的，但并不一定能够确定决定性错误。 局部偏差可能随后得到纠正，对最终结果没有影响，也可能与其他错误共存。 相反，决定性错误可能没有对应的审计发现。 对信息使用标签的信心并不意味着相应事件就是导致失败的原因。 尽管每次审计都会考虑完整的流程轨迹，但它回答的却是与特定交接环节相关的问题。 全局诊断还必须进一步确定哪个错误是导致执行失败的决定性因素。

paragraphs.en: Every event remains a candidate, including those without audit findings, allowing the global judgment to reconsider uncertain local evidence and distinguish error origins from downstream symptoms. paragraphs.en: We evaluate BLADE on 1,228 failed execution trajectories from two established benchmarks: Who&When ( Zhang et al., 2025 ) , featuring naturally occurring failures, and Who&When Pro ( Liu et al., 2026 ) , featuring injected failures. Who&When includes the Hand-Crafted (HC) subset based on Magentic-One ( Fourney et al., 2024 ) and the Algorithm-Generated (AG) subset built using CaptainAgent ( Song et al., 2024 ) . Our evaluation on Who&When Pro covers three distinct multi-agent architectures: Magentic-One, the debate-based DyLAN ( Liu et al., 2024 ) , and the pipeline-based MetaGPT ( Hong et al., 2024 ) . Together, these five subsets cover diverse collaboration structures and both natural and injected failure settings for evaluating attribution.

paragraphs.en: We compare BLADE against seven representative failure attribution strategies from three categories. Direct attribution includes All-at-once, Step-by-step, and Binary search ( Zhang et al., 2025 ) , which identify decisive errors through different trajectory inspection strategies. Structure-guided localization includes TRIAGE ( Wang, 2026 ) and FALAT ( Rafi et al., 2026 ) , which use structural and dependency information for failure localization. Error-aware diagnosis includes ErrorProbe ( Li et al., 2026 ) and TrajDebug ( Qi et al., 2026 ) , which examine failure evidence and error evolution. For consistent evaluation, all strategies are instantiated under a shared Jev decision interface using identical tasks and recorded trajectories. Implementation details for each strategy are provided in Appendix B.2 .

paragraphs.en: Table 1 reports the performance of BLADE and seven baselines across five subsets. With each subset weighted equally, BLADE achieves the highest macro-average accuracy for both step attribution (57.6%) and agent attribution (66.8%). These exceed the strongest baseline averages by 5.6 percentage points for step attribution (All-at-once, 52.0%) and 2.8 points for agent attribution (TrajDebug, 64.0%). BLADE also achieves the best or tied-best step accuracy on every subset, with three outright wins and two ties. Its step accuracy gains over All-at-once range from 2.2 to 11.1 points, spanning both natural and injected failures across different multi-agent architectures.
paragraphs.zh: 表 1 报告了 BLADE 和七种基线模型在五个子集上的性能。 在每个子集均被赋予相等权重的情况下，BLADE 在步骤归因（57.6%）和智能体归因（66.8%）方面都实现了最高的宏观平均准确率。 这些结果分别比最强基线模型的平均值高出 5.6 个百分点（步骤归因：All-at-once，52.0%）和 2.8 个百分点（智能体归因：TrajDebug，64.0%）。 BLADE 还在每个子集上实现了最佳或并列最佳的步骤准确率，其中有三项完全胜出，两项并列。 与 All-at-once 相比，其步骤准确率的提升范围在 2.2 到 11.1 个百分点之间，涵盖了不同多智能体架构中的自然故障和人为注入的故障。

paragraphs.en: Table 2 examines the contribution of handoff auditing, with the diagnosis question and candidate set held fixed. Dependency context alone yields mixed improvements over All-at-once. paragraphs.en: Auditing more handoffs does not necessarily improve attribution. Figure 4 compares dependency-guided selection with exhaustive auditing under the same diagnosis procedure. BLADE examines only 13–23% as many handoffs while matching or improving step accuracy on AG, Magentic-One, and DyLAN. Its findings are also more concentrated on the annotated decisive step. The choice of sources matters as well: on DyLAN, replacing dependency-guided selection with a recency-based plan under the same audit budget nearly halves the share of findings at the decisive step and reduces attribution accuracy. Dependency reconstruction thus serves not merely to represent information flow, but to identify which interactions warrant closer inspection.
paragraphs.zh: 审计更多交接环节并不一定能提升归因准确性。 图 4 在相同诊断流程下，比较了依赖引导式选择与全面审计的效果。 BLADE 仅检查了 13%–23% 的交接环节，但其在 AG、Magentic-One 和 DyLAN 上的步骤准确率与全面审计相当甚至更高。 其发现也更集中于已标注的关键决定步骤。 来源的选择同样重要：在 DyLAN 上，若采用基于近期性的方案替代依赖引导式选择，且审计预算不变，则关键决定步骤的发现比例几乎减半，归因准确性也会下降。 因此，依赖关系的重建不仅用于表示信息流，还能识别哪些交互需要更深入的审查。

paragraphs.en: The full BLADE pipeline has an estimated Jev inference cost of approximately $1.9 across all 1,228 trajectories at the published input-token rate. This covers dependency reconstruction, contract auditing, and global diagnosis.
paragraphs.zh: 在已公布的输入令牌速率下，完整的 BLADE 流程在所有 1,228 条轨迹上的预估 Jev 推理成本约为 1.9 美元。 这涵盖了依赖关系重建、合同审计和全局诊断。

sents.zh: 在已公布的输入令牌速率下，完整的 BLADE 流程在所有 1,228 条轨迹上的预估 Jev 推理成本约为 1.9 美元。

sents.en: This covers dependency reconstruction, contract auditing, and global diagnosis.
sents.zh: 这涵盖了依赖关系重建、合同审计和全局诊断。

paragraphs.en: Dependencies reveal where information came from; auditing its use helps locate where errors were introduced. BLADE audits the handoffs that the dependencies select and leaves the verdict to a global diagnosis that may overrule the audit. With one decision model and no reference answer, this gives the best or tied-best step accuracy among eight methods on five subsets, and the blame graph exposes the local evidence available to each diagnosis. The experiments also carry a broader lesson: dependency information alone is not sufficient for reliable attribution, whereas examining how agents use their sources consistently improves localization, and selective auditing can be more effective than examining every possible interaction. Because every judgment is a typed question, any model that returns option probabilities can take Jev’s place; testing such models, and auditing richer contracts than the task’s requirement spans, are natural next steps toward reliable agentic systems.
paragraphs.zh: 依赖关系揭示了信息的来源；审计其使用方式有助于定位错误引入的位置。 BLADE 会审计依赖关系所选择的信息交接环节，并将最终判断交由全局诊断，该诊断可能推翻审计结果。 在只有一个决策模型且没有参考答案的情况下，这种方法在五个子集上实现了八种方法中最佳或并列最佳的步骤准确率，而责任图则揭示了每次诊断可用的局部证据。 这些实验还带来了一个更广泛的启示：仅凭依赖关系信息不足以实现可靠的归因；相反，持续考察智能体如何使用其信息来源，能够提升问题定位的准确性，而选择性审计可能比检查所有可能的交互更为有效。 由于每个判断都是一个带类型的问题，任何能返回选项概率的模型都可以替代 Jev；测试这类模型，并审计超出任务要求范围的更复杂契约，是构建可靠智能体系统的自然后续步骤。

While these benchmarks provide diverse settings for failure attribution, broader evaluation on real-world workflows and additional task domains would further establish the generalizability of our findings.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的评估涵盖了 Who&When 和 Who&When Pro 的五个子集，涉及不同的多智能体架构以及自然发生的故障和人为注入的故障。 尽管这些基准测试为故障归因提供了多样化的场景，但在真实工作流程和更多任务领域上进行更广泛的评估，将能进一步验证我们研究结果的普适性。

paragraphs.en: BLADE relies on recorded execution traces, and its attribution quality depends on the availability of relevant observations and interactions. Evaluating other compatible decision models would help assess how the framework generalizes across backbones.

paragraphs.en: This work studies failure attribution in LLM multi-agent systems using existing research benchmarks. Our experiments do not involve new human-subject data collection or interventions in deployed systems. BLADE is intended to support retrospective failure diagnosis and debugging.

Tasks, agents, event ids and authors are unchanged.

paragraphs.en: The task is split into exact substrings: at list items when it has at least two; otherwise at discourse markers (first, second, next, then, additionally, furthermore, moreover, also, finally, lastly) when there are at least two; otherwise at semicolons when there are at least two; otherwise into sentences.
paragraphs.zh: 该任务被拆分为精确的子字符串：如果至少有两个项目，则按列表项拆分；否则，如果至少有两个话语标记（first, second, next, then, additionally, furthermore, moreover, also, finally, lastly），则按这些标记拆分；否则，如果至少有两个分号，则按分号拆分；否则，按句子拆分。

paragraphs.en: The seven trace-based adaptations use structured Jev judgments over identical tasks and trajectories, without auxiliary free-form generation. All-at-once predicts agent and step; other methods use the selected step’s recorded actor.
paragraphs.zh: 这七种基于轨迹的变体方法在相同任务和轨迹上使用了结构化的 Jev 判断，且无需辅助的自由形式生成。 “全一次性”方法会同时预测智能体和步骤；其他方法则使用所选步骤中已记录的执行者。

paragraphs.en: All-at-once uses the complete trajectory; Step-by-step searches sequentially; Binary search repeatedly halves the candidate segment ( Zhang et al., 2025 ) .
paragraphs.zh: “全一次性”方法使用完整的轨迹；“分步”方法按顺序进行搜索；“二分搜索”则重复地将候选段减半（Zhang 等人，2025）。

paragraphs.en: TRIAGE ( Wang, 2026 ) ranks steps by suspicion and structural impact. FALAT ( Rafi et al., 2026 ) screens relevant candidate steps and uses influence, propagation, and correction judgments to prune candidates and refine localization.
paragraphs.zh: TRIAGE（Wang，2026）根据怀疑程度和结构性影响对步骤进行排序。 FALAT（Rafi 等，2026）筛选相关的候选步骤，并利用影响、传播和修正判断来剪枝候选步骤并优化定位。

sents.zh: TRIAGE（Wang，2026）根据怀疑程度和结构性影响对步骤进行排序。

sents.en: FALAT ( Rafi et al., 2026 ) screens relevant candidate steps and uses influence, propagation, and correction judgments to prune candidates and refine localization.
sents.zh: FALAT（Rafi 等，2026）筛选相关的候选步骤，并利用影响、传播和修正判断来剪枝候选步骤并优化定位。

paragraphs.en: TrajDebug ( Qi et al., 2026 ) tracks triggers, resolution, and downstream impact to select a decisive step.
